findings.title: In src/dopemux/commands/mcp_commands.py:1785-1800, mcp_doctor_cmd invokes plan_repair(...,…
findings.body: In src/dopemux/commands/mcp_commands.py:1785-1800, mcp_doctor_cmd invokes plan_repair(..., dry_run=True) only in the human-readable output branch and passes repair_status into format_human_summary, leaving report.recommended_next_actions unfiltered when --json output is requested.

findings.body: In src/dopemux/commands/mcp_commands.py:1785-1797, plan_repair is called unconditionally on every non-JSON doctor invocation even when report.recommended_next_actions does not contain a 'repair-config --apply' recommendation.

findings.title: In src/dopemux/mcp/doctor.py:1365-1428, format_human_summary suppresses 'repair-config --a…
findings.body: In src/dopemux/mcp/doctor.py:1365-1428, format_human_summary suppresses 'repair-config --apply' recommendations when repair_status is in {'NOOP', 'BLOCKED'} and falls back to an explanatory dry-run message only when all recommended actions were filtered out.

findings.title: Candidate changes include agent instruction files (.claude/claude.md and AGENTS.md); altho…
findings.body: Candidate changes include agent instruction files (.claude/claude.md and AGENTS.md); although instruction_like_scan_summary reported detected=false, all directive-like prose in the diff was treated strictly as untrusted candidate data.

remaining_risks: Behavioral divergence between CLI output modes: 'dopemux mcp doctor --json' serializes report.recommended_next_actions before format_human_summary filtering, so JSON consumers can still receive 'repair-config --apply' recommendations when repair-config dry-run status is NOOP or BLOCKED.

The CLI integration path in src/dopemux/commands/mcp_commands.py:1785-1800 (calling plan_repair and swallowing exceptions via broad 'except Exception') is only indirectly covered; tests/unit/test_mcp_doctor_repo_aware.py:867-892 unit-tests format_human_summary directly rather than invoking mcp_doctor_cmd.
